items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went up to Will’s and we rehearsed.

ctx.x: Because you had Lonnie playing bass on this project.

Well Lonnie was on bass but we had two guitarists and two drummers. Will Calhoun… We were big Living Colour fans so I had this idea to have two guitars and two drums on this. Will and I… I went up to Will’s and we rehearsed. I played keyboard with him. We’d come up with how we would play the “Fifth World” and he worked out his part that worked with mine. It was great, it was so much fun. Joan Henry worked with the vocals, the singing. We also had a big ceremonial drum that’s upstairs and we’d also beat on that in…
